description: This file implements netlink message handling for Linux, specifically for retrieving task statistics via cgroups and netlink sockets, including message preparation, parsing responses, and utility functions.

classes.name: netlinkMessage
classes.description: Represents a netlink message with header, generic header, and data.

classes.name: loadStatsResp
classes.description: Holds the response structure for load statistics including header, generic header, and load stats.

methods.name: toRawMsg
methods.description: Converts a netlinkMessage to a raw syscall.NetlinkMessage for transmission.

methods.name: padding
methods.description: Calculates padding needed to align size to a specified boundary.

methods.name: getFamilyID
methods.description: Retrieves the family ID for the taskstats subsystem via netlink.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds an attribute to a netlink message buffer with proper padding.

methods.name: prepareMessage
methods.description: Prepares a netlink message with headers and attributes.

methods.name: prepareFamilyMessage
methods.description: Creates a message to query the family ID for task stats.

methods.name: prepareCmdMessage
methods.description: Creates a message to query task stats for a specific cgroup.

methods.name: parseFamilyResp
methods.description: Parses the response to extract the family ID.

methods.name: parseLoadStatsResp
methods.description: Parses the response to extract load statistics.

methods.name: verifyHeader
methods.description: Checks the netlink message header for errors.

methods.name: getLoadStats
methods.description: Retrieves load statistics for a given cgroup via netlink.
